facts.finding: The loader reads original integer time, casts it to int64 and indexes the frame by that value. It supplies no field-specific server-wall/physical-UTC bridge.

The session schedule converts the exchange-local anchor to a UTC epoch, then requires both symbols at every raw integer minute from anchor-30 through anchor+74 before constructing an event. API documentation claiming UTC cannot by itself certify this particular stored field; the broker server convention is a separate authority.
Only those prefiltered events enter the simulation loop. Intended entry is anchor+5, so +6 through +74 are future availability, not then-known admission information.
The turnover denominator counts dates with at least one prefiltered complete event. It is not every original-source trading date.
The structural summary also derives its active dates and nominal slot density from prefiltered complete events. Those counts do not repair a causal admission population.

economic_implication_limit: No missing event opening body/direction/return is opened. The counts do not establish a favorable or adverse profit effect. Existing numbers remain descriptive for the implemented retrospective population, not a complete prospective policy or a valid unchanged native-turnover result.
